name: io.github.Propertyscout001/puntersedge
description: Australian and New Zealand racing plus Australian sports odds for AI agents. Read-only tools.

environmentVariables.name: PUNTERSEDGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: PuntersEdge API key. Free tier is 3,000 credits/month with no card required — get one at https://puntersedge.online/api. The two demo tools work without a key.

environmentVariables.name: PUNTERSEDGE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.puntersedge.online — you should not normally set this.
